definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex: level one (tex:1125-1132): Y^\dag\cdot X=\braket{Y}{X}\,\wt{Q}, Y^\dag\cdot X=\Co_{Q}(Y^{\dag}X), \wt{Q}=\Co_Q(Q); |\braket{X}{X}-||X||^2| <= O(\delta+\eps)||X||^2.
